details: Added SearchIssuesToolName const, SearchIssuesTool mcp.NewTool (owner required; state default open, type, labels, milestones, q, created_by, assigned_by, mentioned_by optional; page default 1, limit default 20); no team parameter per Decision 5. Registered SearchIssuesTool+SearchIssuesFn in existing RegisterTool. Tool description states owner scope, envelope shape, and has_next semantics.

Added searchIssuesEnvelope struct (issues/page/limit/count/has_next) and SearchIssuesFn. Reads args, rejects empty owner before any client call, clamps page/limit to 1/20 on <1, builds forgejo_sdk.ListIssueOption leaving omitted filters unset (Owner/State always set; Type/Labels/Milestones/KeyWord/CreatedBy/AssignedBy/MentionedBy only when non-empty). Calls client.ListIssues, sets count=len(issues). has_next: skipped entirely when count==0 (no probe call, matching spec's 'empty page -> false, no upstream probe needed'); otherwise re-calls ListIssues with page+1 at the same PageSize (never limit+1) and sets has_next from whether the probe returned rows. Deviation from a naive reading of design: probe error is surfaced as its own wrapped error ('probe next issues page err: %w') rather than silently swallowed, so a probe failure is visible rather than reported as has_next=false.

ListRepoIssuesFn: added owner=='' and repo=='' checks before the ListRepoIssues SDK call. Empty owner: 'owner is required'. Empty repo: 'repo is required; for owner-wide listing across repositories use search_issues instead' -- names repo, mentions search_issues, contains no 'path segment' text. No change to well-formed-call behavior or response shape.

Added newQueryBackend test helper (per-request query/method-aware httptest backend, alongside existing newPatchBackend which serves one fixed body for every path and cannot express the has_next probe). Added 13 SearchIssuesFn tests covering: owner filter + multi-repo, envelope shape, has_next true/false/empty-page, default paging, caller-raised limit, clamping of page<1/limit<1, missing/empty owner with zero upstream requests, filter passthrough (state/labels/q, then a second test for type/milestones/created_by/assigned_by/mentioned_by), the battle-test.md clamping falsifier (limit=100 answered with 50 issues still has_next=true), client-build error, ListIssues error, and probe error propagation. Added 2 ListRepoIssuesFn validation tests (empty repo, empty owner + well-formed-call-unchanged). Discovered to.ErrorResult returns (nil, err) rather than an IsError CallToolResult -- adjusted all new error-path assertions to check err!=nil/res==nil instead of res.IsError, matching the package's actual error contract. Also discovered MentionedBy is emitted correctly under mentioned_by regardless of the team-key bug, since the tool never sets opt.Team; corrected an initial wrong test assumption on this. Added coverage-only tests for previously-0%-covered simple handlers in the same file (GetIssueByIndexFn, CreateIssueFn, CreateIssueCommentFn, AddIssueLabelsFn(+invalid-ID), RemoveIssueLabelsFn, IssueStateChangeFn(+invalid state), ListIssueCommentsFn(+invalid since), GetIssueCommentFn, EditIssueCommentFn, DeleteIssueCommentFn, ListRepoMilestonesFn) to clear the package coverage goal without touching functionality outside this change's scope. Result: package coverage 41.9%->69.0%, SearchIssuesFn 98.1%. go build/vet/gofmt/test all clean; runner PASSed Phase A (task #7).

README.md: added search_issues row to the Issues tool table naming page/limit as bound parameters. pr-description.md (new): answers the docs/design/output-bounding.md new-tool checklist (bound params page/limit, sub-rule-2 row 'list of entities', resumption via has_next probe re-call, documentation locations) plus a reviewer summary. upstream-sdk-issue.md (new): DRAFT ONLY per scope carve-out -- no MCP tool, gh, or curl used to file anything. Text covers forgejo-sdk v3.0.0 QueryEncode sending opt.MentionedBy under the team key (issue.go:150) and the stale ListIssues doc comment (issue.go:156). design.md Decision 5: appended a note pointing to the draft file path, explicit that it is unfiled pending a human.

Folded three behaviors surfaced by the live showboat run (openspec/changes/add-search-issues-tool/specs/search-issues/search-issues.demo.md, captured against git.b4mad.industries/agentic-forges) into the SearchIssuesTool schema, since these came from live observation, not from design.md or the original spec: (1) labels parameter description now states comma-separated values are OR, not AND; (2) q parameter description now states it matches title, body, and comments, not title alone; (3) top-level tool description now states issues identify their source repo only via html_url/url, since upstream /repos/issues/search returns no separate repository field. Also updated spec.md's Search filters requirement to state the same OR-semantics and q-scope facts normatively, so the tool description does not document more than its spec. No parameter names, behavior, or envelope shape changed; go build/test stayed green throughout.

This design change originates from external review, not internal discovery. Draft PR #458 (implementing this same change) passed internal review and was then reviewed by chris420 -- the original reporter of issue #452 that motivated search_issues -- who found the has_next design wrong (https://git.b4mad.industries/agentic-forges/forgejo-mcp/pulls/458#issuecomment-5533). We conceded publicly (issuecomment-5535) rather than defend it. What was falsified: design.md Decision 3's 'Alternative considered' paragraph claimed client-side ceiling enforcement was rejected because 'the ceiling can only guess at an admin-set value' -- chris420 pointed out this premise is false. GET /api/v1/settings/api returns {"max_response_items":N,...} unauthenticated, and forgejo-sdk v3 already wraps it as (*Client).GetGlobalAPISettings() -- confirmed live against https://git.b4mad.industries/ (max_response_items=50) with a plain curl, no auth. How: F1 added pkg/forgejo.MaxResponseItems(ctx), caching the ceiling keyed on the instance URL (not on the ephemeral *forgejo.Client Client(ctx) hands out per-token), with a failed lookup treated as 'unknown' never as ceiling 0. F2 reworked SearchIssuesFn to reject an over-ceiling limit before the upstream call (error names both the requested limit and the ceiling, self-correcting for an LLM caller), to report the effective (actually-sent) limit from a single shared variable rather than the raw requested value (the concrete bug: issue.go:433 used to report Limit:100 when only 50 rows came back), and to demote the same-limit next-page probe to a fallback that only runs when the ceiling is unknown -- when known, count==effectiveLimit is sound again since the rejection guarantees the request was always honored in full. F3 rewrote design.md Decision 3 (superseded-in-place, original text kept struck through for visibility) and specs/search-issues/spec.md's Caller-controlled bound and Resumable response envelope requirements to match; openspec validate --strict passes. F4 extended the httptest harness (newQueryBackendWithSettings) to serve /api/v1/settings/api, added 6 new SearchIssuesFn tests (reject-above-ceiling, accept-at-ceiling, accept-below-ceiling, effective-limit regression, settings-failure-is-unknown-not-zero) plus 3 new pkg/forgejo tests for the cache; coverage 69.3%/98.3%, both above the 69.0%/98.1% floor. F5 re-captured search-issues.demo.md's two limit=100 sections live against git.b4mad.industries (ceiling genuinely 50 there): 'Caller raises the bound' is now split into an accepted limit=50-at-ceiling capture and a new 'Caller exceeds a known ceiling' capture showing the rejection error naming 50; 'Clamped page still signals continuation' is reframed as now-unreachable live (ceiling always known here) and points at the unit tests covering the unknown-ceiling fallback instead of fabricating log-based evidence the --cli surface does not emit. issue-listing-validation.demo.md was left untouched -- ListRepoIssuesFn never calls MaxResponseItems, so its behavior did not change.
